{{Documentation subpage}}
{{High-use}}

{{Lua|Module:Check for unknown parameters|Module:InfoboxImage|Module:String|Module:String2|Module:WikidataIB|Module:Infobox mapframe|Module:Infobox power station}}
{{TOC right}}
Use this infobox for all types of [[:en:power station|power station]]s. For [[:en:Hydroelectricity#Generating methods|hydroelectric]] power stations involving dams (except tidal facilities), please use {{Tl|Infobox dam}}.

== Usage ==
=== Wikidata-enabled ===
Simply add <code><nowiki>{{Infobox power station}}</nowiki></code> to the top of an article belonging to any type of power station, and the data will be automatically included from [[:en:Wikidata|Wikidata]]. If necessary, these values can be overridden by passing local values to the relevant parameters in the article:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext" style="overflow:auto">
{{Infobox power station
| name = [local value]
}}
</syntaxhighlight>
To add data to Wikidata, please see the Parameters section below.

| colspan="3" style="background-color:#FFFFE6;text-align:center;" | '''Power generation''' (used by all power station types)
|-
| '''ps_units_operational''' || For each unit, set <code>{{Property|P516}}</code> as the model of the generation unit (or unknown value), with the following qualifiers:<br>{{*}} <code>{{Property|P2109}}</code> (if different from unit's standard capacity)<br>{{*}} Set <code>{{Property|P571}}</code> for date construction began (or unknown value)<br>{{*}} Set <code>{{Property|P729}}</code> for date unit commissioned (or unknown value)<br>{{*}} Do ''not'' set <code>{{Property|P730}}</code> for date unit decommissioned. 
{{Dividing line}}
For facilities with large sets of identical units (i.e. in wind farms), use qualifier {{Property|P1114}} to ''multiply'' the entry.
|| Number of currently operational turbines/generating units.
|-
| '''ps_units_manu_model''' || This parameter will be auto-populated based on <code>{{Property|P516}}</code> for <code>ps_units_operational</code>. <code>{{Property|P176}}</code> must be set in the generation unit model's Wikidata item. || Shortened name(s) of manufacturers and models of '''currently operational''' turbines/generating units.
|-
| '''ps_units_planned''' || For each unit, set <code>{{Property|P516}}</code> as the model of the generation unit (or unknown value), with the following qualifiers:<br>{{*}} <code>{{Property|P2109}}</code> (if different from unit's standard capacity)<br>{{*}} Do ''not'' set <code>{{Property|P571}}</code> for date construction began<br>{{*}} Do ''not'' set <code>{{Property|P729}}</code> for date unit commissioned<br>{{*}} Do ''not'' set <code>{{Property|P730}}</code> for date unit decommissioned. || Number of generating units currently planned/proposed for installation.
|-
| '''ps_units_cancelled''' || For each unit, set <code>{{Property|P516}}</code> as the model of the generation unit (or unknown value), with the following qualifiers:<br>{{*}} <code>{{Property|P2109}}</code> (if different from unit's standard capacity)<br>{{*}} Set <code>{{Property|P5817}}</code> as <code>{{Q|Q30108381}}</code> || Number of planned generating units cancelled.
|-
| '''ps_units_uc''' || For each unit, set <code>{{Property|P516}}</code> as the model of the generation unit (or unknown value), with the following qualifiers:<br>{{*}} <code>{{Property|P2109}}</code> (if different from unit's standard capacity)<br>{{*}} Set <code>{{Property|P571}}</code> for date construction began (or unknown value)<br>{{*}} Do ''not'' set <code>{{Property|P729}}</code> for date unit commissioned<br>{{*}} Do ''not'' set <code>{{Property|P730}}</code> for date unit decommissioned. || Number of generating units under construction.
|-
| '''ps_units_decommissioned''' || For each unit, set <code>{{Property|P516}}</code> as the model of the generation unit (or unknown value), with the following qualifiers:<br>{{*}} <code>{{Property|P2109}}</code> (if different from unit's standard capacity)<br>{{*}} Set <code>{{Property|P571}}</code> for date construction began (or unknown value)<br>{{*}} Set <code>{{Property|P729}}</code> for date unit commissioned (or unknown value)<br>{{*}} Set <code>{{Property|P730}}</code> for date unit decommissioned (or unknown value) || Number of generating units decommissioned or under decommissioning.
|-
| '''ps_electrical_capacity''' || <code>{{Property|P2109}}</code> with qualifier <code>{{Property|P459}}</code> as <code>{{Q|Q200974}}</code> || Current net installed [[:en:Nameplate capacity|capacity]] in megawatts, or planned capacity for those under development. <code>[[:en:Megawatt|MW]]</code> suffix will auto added for values without units.<br>For those which are operational, but with additional under development, please add only the current installed value.
|-
| '''ps_electrical_cap_fac''' || <code>{{Property|P6639}}</code> || [[:en:Capacity factor|Capacity factor]] of the power station, in percentage as given from referenced source.
|-
| '''ps_annual_generation''' || <code>{{Property|P4131}}</code> with optional qualifier <code>{{Property|P585}}</code> || Average annual net generation. <code>[[:en:GW·h|GW·h]]</code> suffix will auto added for number without unit or text appended.
|-
| '''ps_storage_capacity''' || <code>{{Property|P4140}}</code> || [[Energy storage#Storage capacity|Storage capacity]] of the power station.
|-
| '''website''' || <code>{{Property|P856}}</code> || Official website.
|-
|}

== FAQ ==
# '''The article displays little or no information when <code><nowiki>{{Infobox power station}}</nowiki></code> is added to the top of an article.'''<br>Information about the particular power station may not be added to Wikidata yet, or may not have been added correctly. Click on the "Edit on Wikidata" button on the bottom of the infobox to add or modify the necessary data. Refer to the Parameters table above for structuring format.
# '''The Wikidata entry is accurate, but I want to override one or more parameter(s) on a particular article.'''<br>You may add the necessary parameter name and value to force a local value. See the [[#Standard usage]] section above.
# '''I want to add unique (i.e. localised) information to a particular article, but creating a whole new parameter is redundant.'''<br>This infobox supports up to 5 special parameters in the form of <code>|ps_label1=</code> and <code>|ps_data1=</code>. You may use it for a custom label and value. The values will be appended before the "Power generation" section.
# '''I'm not comfortable with using data from Wikidata, as that is a separate wiki and I cannot monitor changes in my local watchlist.'''<br>Wikidata edits relating to locally watched articles now show on the local watchlist. Select the <code>Show Wikidata edits in your watchlist</code> option under the "Watchlist" tab in your [[Special:Preferences|Preferences]].
